title: daily-scratchpad-gpu-ops-38
content:
03/04/2026 - quick scratchpad (SAM)

Morning checklist
- Quick healthcheck for GPU cluster (rack-gpu-01..04) — look for driver/kernel mismatches, OOM kills.
- Confirm dedicated pool capacity after last night’s ramp (customer: AtlasCorp).
- Verify scheduled network maintenance window tonight (22:00 UTC) and impact surface for dedicated/private customers.

Current priorities
1) Capacity forecasting for next 30 days
   - Pull last 14 days p50/p95 token throughput + per-model batch sizes from billing analytics.
   - Update capacity plan spreadsheet (link in linked_artifacts). Need final numbers for commit meeting on Tue.
2) GPU driver update on rack-gpu-03
   - Kernel mismatch seen on node-3b (nv 535 vs 540). Reboot planned after drain.
   - TODO: run ansible playbook gpu-driver-upgrade (dry-run) -> then drain node -> apply -> smoke test.
3) Networking: port ranges for dedicated pools
   - Rack team asked to confirm NAT gateway rules. Need to open 10000-11000/TCP for model shard sync between nodes.
   - Follow up with Priya (neteng) before 18:00.

Ops notes / commands
- Check node status: kubectl get nodes -l pool=gpu --show-labels
- Drain: kubectl drain node/rack-gpu-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
- Run smoke: ./scripts/smoke-test-inference --model redwood-13b --min-latency 10ms
- Grafana panels: GPU util, memory alloc, OOM events (dashboard id abc123)

Reminders / unresolved
- Investigate recurring OOMs on tenant-c for long-context workloads. Might need KV-cache tweaks or bump to 48GB shard config.
- Prefetch/warmup: trigger prewarm for hot model versions before traffic spike (canpush to rollout hooks?).
- Confirm whether Dedicated autoscaler supports burst-to-hosted fallback — doc claims yes but need test case.

Notes to self
- If upgrade fails, rollback sequence: revert driver via puppet, reattach node to pool after validating kernel modules.
- Keep customer success looped for AtlasCorp (low-latency SLA).

Quick TO-DO (today)
- [ ] Run capacity pull + update spreadsheet (by EOD)
- [ ] Dry-run driver playbook on staging cluster (by 14:30)
- [ ] Call with Priya re: NAT rules (13:00)
- [ ] Add smoke test to nightly pipeline if not already present (ticketed)

Open questions for next sync
- How aggressive should prewarm be for non-critical models? cost vs latency tradeoff.
- Any constraints from security on opening 10k-11k ports (audit?).

Misc notes
- Slack threads: #infra-gpu (thread: "rack-gpu-03 driver")
- Related tickets: JIRA-INFRA-4291 (capacity forecast), JIRA-INFRA-4310 (driver upgrade runbook)

END
